notes: First results from ABRACADABRA-10cm broadband haloscope search for axion dark matter, mass range 3.1e-10 to 8.3e-9 eV (75 kHz - 2 MHz). No numerical table provided; the endpoints are the explicitly quoted values, and intermediate points are approximate interpolations of the Fig. 3 exclusion curve (limit improves with increasing mass as low-frequency vibrational noise subsides).
